title: Infantry Marines Take to the Air
description: Marines with 3rd Battalion, 3rd Marines conduct training with CH-46E Sea Knight helicopters. The Marines were tasked with gathering intelligence, then performing an emergency evacuation. Lance Cpl. Natalie Rostran took a ride to the landing zone for a first hand look at the Marines in action. Includes sound bites from 1st Lt. Christopher Toomer, Platoon Commander, 3rd Battalion, 3rd Marines and Capt. Joseph McConnell, CH-46E Pilot, HMM-262.
